values.description: Minimises impact during an accident by inflating a baloon-like bag that acts as a cushion to soften the blow to passengers and reducing risk of serious injury.
Applies brakes to individual tyres so that the car does not spin off, while you try to avoid objects on road.
Detects slipping of a wheel when accelerating, and reduces wheel speed by braking or cutting off power, to maintain maximum traction at each wheel.
Detects low light conditions using photoelectric sensors, and automatically switches on head lamps to improve visibility.
Activates car headlights for a short period after the car is locked to illuminate dark areas and help you get home safely.
Monitors pressure in all 4 tyres, & alerts you in real time if it detects a drop or rise in pressure, thus reducing accident risk & increasing tyre life.
Stops the car from rolling back while you're driving uphill, giving time to move the foot from the brake to the accelerator to move the car upward.
Makes reversing the car easier, as it gives you a clear view of what's behind you.
Provides a way for the child seat to be firmly fixed to the car, so that the child stays safe as seatbelts cannot hold children.
Prevents tyres from locking up, and thus, skidding, during sudden braking, and allows you to steer the car to safety.
Does not let the car start unless the right key is inside the vehicle. Saves car from getting hotwired, and thus prevents theft.
Makes parking the car easier for you, by providing sound alerts in case an obstacle is detected in the car's path.
Alerts you if the headlamps or ignition is on while leaving the car, by setting off an alarm.
Allows you to control all door locks from the driver door lock, for safety & convenience.
Distributes braking force between each wheel optimally for effective braking, hence helping improve stopping distances and maintain control during emergency braking situations.
Automatically locks all car doors once the car goes above a minimum speed designated by the manufacturer.
Allows you to operate all car door locks electrically, by using the driver door lock or remote.
Prevents rear doors from being opened using the handles on the inside, thus making it safe for children travelling in the back who are likely to fiddle with the handles.
Informs you of an open door while the car is moving, via a sound or visual alert system.
Uses a 4-camera setup to give a complete view around the car, as if you were looking from above it. Makes it easier to park, especially in tight spaces.
Detects objects in the driver's blind spots and informs the driver via visual or audible signals.
Rotates both wheels on the axle at the same speed in all conditions. Useful when offroading or when the car is stuck in muddy areas.
Installed alongside headlamps, these additional lights automatically switch on when steering is turned, to increase visibility at turns during the night.
Detects rise in car speed without input from the accelarator while the car is going downhill, and reduces the speed by braking.
A feature that allows you to engage or disengage the handbrake with the press of a button instead of pulling the lever.
Automatically notifies emergency services in your location in case of a crash. You can also press the SOS button to call emergency services manually.
Sends an alert to your phone when the car moves out of a virtual fence on the map, previously set by you.
Allows you to drive at constant speed without pressing the accelerator; useful for highway driving. On pressing brakes, feature is deactivated for safety.
Works like a home AC and maintains the set temperature, thus saving fuel by switching compressor off when not needed.
Dedicatedly cools the rear part of the car, keeping passengers at the back cool and comfortable on their journeys.
Allows you to turn on the car's engine without inserting the keys into the ignition. You only need to press the start/ stop button & keep the key in the car with you.
Lets you to keep your beverages chilled while you're on the go, via cooling ducts installed in the glove box.
Allows you to control music, trip meter, etc., via buttons installed on the steering wheel, so that you can stay focused on the road while driving.
Allows you to open the car doors with the press of a button on the door handle or on the key itself.
Helps you roll up or roll down windows by pressing a button, controlled by a motor.
Allows you to move the driver seat front and back, change the recline angle or height, and in some cases adjust lumbar support according to your comfort & preference.
Lets you lower power windows with a single press of a button, thus taking away the hassle of continuously holding the button till windows go all the way down.
Allows you to control certain pre-defined functions in a car, like climate control and audio volume with voice inputs.
Retractable blinds provided on the rear windows to cover and reduce the sunlight coming in.
Supplies air through micro ducts in the seat to keep you & your co-passengers comfortable while driving.
Let's you charge your smartphone without a connecting cable. You simply place your phone on the car's wireless charging pad, provided it supports this feature.
Allows you to control seat adjustability with minimum effort via a switch motor, and maintain a comfortable position on your drives.
Allows you to maintain two different temperature settings on the driver and front passenger side of the car.
Allows you to shift gears without taking your hands off the wheel, as these race-car inspired shifters are mounted to the steering wheel/ column itself.
Allows you to open or close the car's boot/ dickey door electrically (without any manual effort), by using a button or a remote.
Allows you to track your car's location in real time, by means of a GPS chip.
Indicates the current gear that the vehicle is being driven in.
Allows you to connect your Android/iOS phone to the car screen, and access apps on your phone, without having to use the handset.
Presents important data on a transparent display in front of you, thus allowing you to drive safely without taking your eyes of the road.
Displays distance travelled since the last reset, & is used to measure distance travelled for a particular trip/ time period only.

values.display_name: Leather wrapped gear knob/ shift selector

values.description: Displays engine speed in revolutions per minute (RPM), and helps you estimate when to change gears.
Removes fogging from rear/ back windshield by activating a grid of heating coils to heat the windshield. Maintains good rear visibility especially during rains & winter.
Helps you roll up or roll down rear/ back windows by pressing a button, controlled by a switch motor.
Provides better visibility in poor weather situations (fog, mist, etc.). Placed below headlamps in the front of the car to directly illuminate the road.
Detects water on the windshield via sensors, and automatically activates wipers. Helps maintain a clear windshield in bad weather, without manual input.
Enhances car's exterior appearance vis-a-vis aesthetics/ aerodynamics; kit typically consists of front/ rear bumpers, spoilers, side skirts, etc. to be installed on car body.

values.description: The horizontal distance between the centres of the front and the rear tyres.
Weight of the vehicle including a full tank of fuel & all standard equipment. Doesn't include the weight of passengers, cargo or optional equipment.
The chain of components that deliver power from the engine to the tyres.
Defines the size of an engine. It is the volume of the cylinder when the piston is at the lowermost point multiplied by the no. of cylinders.
The number of cylinders present in an engine. This number depends on the purpose served by the engine.
Pushes more air inside the cylinder for better combustion of fuel. It's powered by the exhaust gases that come out of an engine.
Maximum power refers to the maximum measured horsepower output of an engine at rated speeds as stated by the manufacturer.
Maximum torque is the highest value of the net torque measured at full engine load.
Changes car behaviour based on driver selection to provide economical, sporty or comfortable drives.
Tilt: 'Up' and 'down' change in position of the steering wheel; Telescopic: 'In' and 'out' movement of the steering wheel.
The radius of the circle in which the vehicle will move without skidding when the steering has been turned to its extreme end.
